study_note: Three-seed, 14-million-decision Humanoid Walk study derived from the base-v1 G4 min_all reward-only configuration, with the declared dual replay behavior-policy-KL controls as its only learning-axis changes. At step zero and every 50,000 agent decisions it retains the Figure-1 paper-deterministic and stochastic-Bellman value-calibration protocols with 100 fixed-seed samples per estimate. The same evaluation event also runs the Figure-2-left paired-controller protocol for five environment-seed-paired episodes using seed 12345: deterministic outer-only control versus deterministic execution after a fresh action-local inner SAC solve at every state. It records the fixed-target root-Q action gain with inner_diagnostic_rollouts=0, so that diagnostic adds no imagined model trajectories. The real return delta is primary; positive fixed-Q gain together with negative real return delta indicates critic/model optimism or compounded distribution shift. The additional real rollouts and per-state inner solves are evaluation-only compute, timed separately, and are not charged to the 14-million-decision training budget. The paired controller and value-calibration probes are observational; all five Q heads, both reward-only critic targets, the cloned inner critic, automatic outer and inner entropy coefficients, and no actor-loss percentile scaling remain unchanged.
